title: Beat Maker demo
description: Three short Beat Maker tasks: a pattern is a string. Not published; a demo for lesson writers.

tasks.title: Change one character
tasks.explainer:
Press **Run** to hear the beat and watch the grid. Each character is one step: `x` is a hit, `.` is a rest.

Add one more snare hit on **step 14** (count from 0). Change one character, then Run again.
tasks.starterCode:
from beats import *

kick  = "x...x...x...x..."
snare = "....x.......x..."
hat   = "x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x."
#> Change one . to an x
play(kick, snare, hat, tempo=100)

check.name: snare
check.hint: Step 14 is the third character from the end. The snare should be "....x.......x.x."

tasks.title: Speed it up
tasks.explainer: The `tempo` is how many beats a minute. Make the beat faster: set `tempo` to **140** and Run.
tasks.starterCode:
from beats import *

kick  = "x...x...x...x..."
snare = "....x.......x..."
hat   = "x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x."
tempo = 100
play(kick, snare, hat, tempo=tempo)

check.name: tempo
check.hint: Change the 100 on the tempo line to 140.

tasks.title: Repeat a bar
tasks.explainer: `"x..." * 4` repeats a pattern 4 times. Make `kick` with `*` so it is `"x...x...x...x..."`, then add a clap: `play(kick, clap="....x.......x...")`.
tasks.starterCode:
from beats import *

#> Use * to repeat "x..." four times
kick = "x..."
play(kick)

check.hint: Use * to repeat the pattern instead of typing it out.
Add a clap by name: play(kick, clap="....x.......x...")
